supporting_observations.claim: During the alerted window, WS-EBROOKS-01 repeatedly connected through the proxy to update.stockpilot.com. The observed connections run from 13:40:34 to 14:10:11 at roughly five-minute intervals, with a failed 502 attempt at 14:06:01.

The successful StockPilot proxy connections are associated with stockpilotupd.exe (PID 6300), which was launched from the installed StockPilot program directory under eli.brooks's interactive session. This process attribution is consistent with the inventory's approved StockPilot updater and its expected approximately five-minute update checks.

The 14:06:01 StockPilot attempt received a proxy gateway error, followed by another connection to the same approved update host at 14:10:11; the evidence does not show a successful connection to a different destination as part of this recurring activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT tunnels and byte counts for StockPilot, but do not expose the HTTPS payload contents; the records therefore do not establish what data or update content was exchanged (for example, T216-00091 and T216-00233).

The process and network records associate stockpilotupd.exe with connections to the explicit proxy at 10.54.20.30:8080; they do not independently establish the updater binary's integrity or the ultimate remote server IP (for example, T216-00092, T216-00094, and T216-00236).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents or safety of data exchanged inside the StockPilot HTTPS tunnels (T216-00091, T216-00233).
The evidence does not establish a hash or signature verification result for stockpilotupd.exe; its path and observed process attribution alone do not prove binary integrity (T216-00087, T216-00092).
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate.exe ran repeatedly as SYSTEM on WS-EBROOKS-01. Dropbox is not listed as approved software; track separately without using this to decide the alert (T216-00024, T216-00027, T216-00173, T216-00180, T216-00257, T216-00260).

GlobalProtect-related activity is present: WS-EBROOKS-01 contacted updates.paloaltonetworks.com and later launched PanGPA.exe. The inventory says there is no VPN and no approved remote administration from this workstation; investigate separately (T216-00030, T216-00031, T216-00266, T216-00268).

The proxy host 10.54.20.30 initiated an RPC connection to WS-EBROOKS-01 on port 135. The inventory limits remote administration to WS-KITO-01; investigate the purpose and authorization separately (T216-00169, T216-00170, T216-00171, T216-00172).

eli.brooks authenticated to WS-RMOSS-01 from source IP 10.54.10.21; the available records do not identify that source host. Review separately against expected help-desk access (T216-00162, T216-00163, T216-00164).

eli.brooks opened a Google Sheets URL in Chrome. Google Sheets is not among the listed approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services; investigate separately (T216-00304, T216-00305, T216-00309, T216-00310).
